params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate - Death in 4 Acts:}} {{cis|Jhin}} gun may fire up to 4 times before needing to reload for a short period. The final round will {{tip|critically strike}}, dealing {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''missing''' health}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate - Every Moment Matters:}} '''Jhin''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, increased by his {{sti|critical strike chance}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. Whenever he {{tip|critically strike|critically strikes}}, he gains a burst of {{sti|{{as|movement speed}}}} based on his {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
params.blurb4: '''Jhin's''' {{sti|{{as|attack speed}}}} cannot increase except by {{sti|xp|leveling}} up, and he deals reduced {{tip|critically strike|critical strike damage}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate - Death In 4 Acts:}} '''Jhin's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} consume [[ammunition]] within 4 rounds. He will reload over {{fd|2.5}} seconds immediately after expending all rounds or withholding leftover rounds after 10 seconds of being [[out of combat]] and not being affected by {{tip|crowd control}}. The latter reload can be interrupted by declaring an attack or casting an ability. '''Jhin''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks during the reload time.
params.description2: '''Jhin's''' final round attack has an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, always {{tip|critically strike|critically strikes}}, including against {{tip|turrets|structures}}, and deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|15 to 25 for 3|1 to 11}} of the target's {{sti|'''missing''' health}}}}. The damage based on the target's health is capped at 800 against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Every Moment Matters:}} '''Jhin''' gains {{sti|ad|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|4;5;6;7;8;9;10;11;12;14;16;20;24;28;32;36;40;44|formula = 4% at + 1% per level up to 9, then + 2% up to 11, then + 4%, capped at level 18}}|attack damage}}<!--stops at 18-->{{ft|{{as|(+ {{fd|0.35}}% per 1% critical strike chance)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.3}}% per 1% '''bonus''' attack speed)}}|{{as|(+ 35% critical strike chance)}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' attack speed)}}}}{{as|AD}}.
params.description4: Additionally, {{tip|critical strikes}} against enemies grant '''Jhin''' {{as|14%|movement speed}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.44}}% per 1% '''bonus''' attack speed)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.
params.flavorsound: {{sm2|Jhin_Original_P4Ready_4.ogg}} ''"One, two, three, four, two, two, three, four."''
params.notes:
* The {{as|{{sti|'''missing''' health}}}} damage benefits from {{sti|life steal}}.
* The '''bonus''' damage based on the target's missing health does not affect structures.
* The 4th attack versus a structure is classified as a critical strike.
* The attack damage multiplier stacks additively with {{bi|Dragon Slayer|Dragon Slayer's}}.
* ''Every Moment Matters' '' bonus {{as|AD}} will benefit from any amount of {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}, even in excess of an amount that would usually reach the attacks per second cap ({{fd|3}}).
** The maximum modifier without attack speed is 79%.
*** 44% base modifier at level 18.
*** 35% from critical strike chance on account of the 100% cap.
*** Sources of {{tip|cripple}} will not affect '''Jhin's''' bonus attack damage from his passive and will ignore his attack speed as it is fixed.
**** However, {{cai|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser}} will reduce '''Jhin's''' bonus attack damage.{{bug|2}}
* Attack damage reductions apply before the multiplier causing them to be stronger against '''Jhin''' than advertised or versus other champions.

blurb.plain: Innate - Death in 4 Acts: Jhin gun may fire up to 4 times before needing to reload for a short period. The final round will critically strike, dealing bonus physical damage based on the target's missing health.

blurb2.plain: Innate - Every Moment Matters: Jhin gains bonus attack damage, increased by his critical strike chance and bonus attack speed. Whenever he critically strikes, he gains a burst of movement speed based on his bonus attack speed.

blurb4.plain: Jhin's attack speed cannot increase except by leveling up, and he deals reduced critical strike damage.

description.plain: Innate - Death In 4 Acts: Jhin's basic attacks consume ammunition within 4 rounds. He will reload over 2.5 seconds immediately after expending all rounds or withholding leftover rounds after 10 seconds of being out of combat and not being affected by crowd control. The latter reload can be interrupted by declaring an attack or casting an ability. Jhin is unable to declare basic attacks during the reload time.

description2.plain: Jhin's final round attack has an uncancellable windup, always critically strikes, including against structures, and deals bonus physical damage equal to 15% – 25% (based on level) of the target's missing health. The damage based on the target's health is capped at 800 against monsters.

description3.plain: Innate - Every Moment Matters: Jhin gains bonus attack damage equal to 4% – 44% (based on level)(+ 0.35% per 1% critical strike chance) (+ 0.3% per 1% bonus attack speed)AD.

description4.plain: Additionally, critical strikes against enemies grant Jhin 14% (+ 0.44% per 1% bonus attack speed) bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jhin}} throws a grenade at the target enemy that can bounce to up to three additional nearby enemies, dealing {{as|physical damage}}.
params.blurb2: The grenade's damage increases any time an enemy dies by any means after being hit by the grenade before it strikes its next target.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' throws a grenade at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}} and can bounce to up to three additional nearby enemies, prioritizing the closest enemy that has not been hit.
params.description2: The grenade's damage is increased by 35% any time an enemy dies by any means after being hit by the grenade before it strikes its next target.
params.notes:
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent the canister from bouncing.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive - Beauty in Death:}} Killing an enemy champion summons a free ''Blooming Lotus Trap'' under them.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jhin}} places a {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} ''Lotus Trap'' at the target location. When an enemy crosses, it will ''bloom'', {{tip|slow|slowing}} and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them. The trap detonates shortly after, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies.
params.blurb3: '''Jhin''' stocks a ''Lotus Trap'' every few seconds, holding up to two.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive - Beauty in Death:}} Whenever '''Jhin''' kills an enemy champion, he summons a ''Blooming Lotus Trap'' on their corpse.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' places a ''Lotus Trap'' at the target location which, upon landing, becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over 1 second, lasting for up to 180 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} within its radius. The ''Lotus Trap blooms'' upon enemy contact, with enemies in the area at the time of its trigger becoming {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for 4 seconds.
params.description3: '''Jhin''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Lotus Trap'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
params.description4: ''Blooming Lotus Traps'' {{tip|slow}} enemies within the area by 35% for 2 seconds before exploding, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies. ''Lotus Traps'' deal 65% damage against {{tip|minions}} as well as against {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} who have been struck by another ''Lotus Trap'' in the last 1 second.
params.description5: ''See [[Jhin#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Lotus Traps.''
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|260|On-trigger reveal and explosion radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|260|Trap sight radius}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Beauty in Death'' does not consume ''Lotus Trap'' charges.
* The ''Lotus Trap'' will stop upon encountering a {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} or {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}}.
* ''Beauty in Death'' does not trigger after killing a {{tip|clone}}.
* The reveal debuff is named [[File: Caught Out.png|20px|link=]] ''Caught Out''.
** This debuff is shared between ''Captive Audience'' and {{ai|Curtain Call|Jhin}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jhin}} {{tip|channels}} up to a period, being able to fire up to four shots in a large cone in front of him.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Jhin''' fires a round in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit based on {{as|their '''missing''' health}}. It stops upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|slow|slowing}} and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for a short time.
params.blurb3: The fourth shot {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}} for {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
params.blurb4: ''Curtain Call'' plays music globally when first activated and its range is always {{tip|obscured|visible}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 10 seconds, transforming his weapon into a cannon and gaining the ability to recast ''Curtain Call'' 4 times within the duration.
params.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} After {{fd|0.2}} seconds into the cast time, '''Jhin''' fires a round in the target direction that grants {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|key1=%|0 to 300 for 11|0 to 100|formula=3% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health.}}}}. The bullet stops upon hitting an enemy champion, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 80% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 2 seconds. Each cast has a {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} of 1 second.
params.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage per Bullet|{{ap|64 to 192}} {{as|(+ 25% AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage per Bullet|{{ap|64*4 to 192*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*4}}% AD)}}}}
params.description3: The fourth shot {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}} for {{as|{{critical damage|200|100}}|critical damage}} damage.
params.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Fourth Shot Damage|{{ap|64*2 to 192*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*2}}% AD)}}|Maximum Fourth Shot Damage|{{ap|(64*2)*4 to (192*2)*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(25*2)*4}}% AD)}}}}
params.notes:
* Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to enemy champions and {{tip|area damage}} to other enemy units.
*Each cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* ''Curtain Call's'' shooting range is fixed in front of '''Jhin'''.
* The opening sound effect and area of range are audible and visible to both teams.
* Leveling up the ability while channeling will change the final cooldown.
* '''Jhin''' will turn to face in the target direction whenever he uses a recast.
* '''Jhin''' gains a wider field of view during ''Curtain Call''.
* The reveal debuff is named [[File: Caught Out.png|20px|link=]] ''Caught Out''.
** This debuff is shared between {{ai|Captive Audience|Jhin}} and ''Curtain Call''.
